record.reason: Focused Forcing is training-free per-frame/head KV compression for autoregressive video diffusion, reporting up to 1.48x acceleration and quality gains. It is strongly adjacent to KV-cache eviction, but evidence is video diffusion only and limitations request validation across other architectures/deployments.
record.title: Focused Forcing: Content-Aware Per-Frame KV Selection for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
